items.q: Does it work for an auto dismantler?
items.a: Yes. Engine and parts tracking, engine sales with documents, price-list imports, and a unified warehouse — that's the core scenario.

items.q: Does it work for a repair shop?
items.a: Yes. Work orders, parts reserved from the warehouse, automatic write-offs when a work order closes, and accounting entries with no double entry.

items.q: We live in Excel. Will we be forced to throw everything out?
items.a: No. Start with warehouse or work orders, import your price lists, and migrate processes gradually. Excel stays as an archive.

items.q: Do I need a developer to set it up?
items.a: No. Open app.myautocore.com in a browser, sign up, invite your team. There's also a desktop app, Windows, and iPhone with the same interface.

items.q: What happens after 14 days? Are there extra fees for modules?
items.a: It's $39 per month per company, or you can pause. Your data is kept. There are no extra fees for modules — one price unlocks the entire product.

items.q: How do I buy a subscription?
items.a: Email support@myautocore.com — we'll help you get set up and started.

meta.title: Security
meta.description: Per-module roles, an activity log, company data isolation, operation audits, and server-side checks.

hero.title: Security for an operational business
hero.description: Built for multi-user operation: access rights, auditing, and transparency aren't an add-on — they're the foundation of the architecture.

pillars.title: Roles and access
pillars.body: Granular permissions per module: warehouse, work orders, accounting, settings. Warehouse staff can't see finances, accountants can't edit stock.

pillars.title: Activity log
pillars.body: Every meaningful change is recorded with the employee, role, and timestamp. Managers see the full picture in Mission Control, no exports needed.

pillars.title: Company isolation
pillars.body: Multi-tenant architecture: each organization's data is isolated at the level of Firestore Security Rules and server-side checks.

pillars.title: Operation audits
pillars.body: A trail for stock, ledger entries, permissions, and documents: a transparent "who · what · when" chain, no "go ask Pete".

principles.title: Least privilege by default
principles.body: A role only grants access to the modules it needs. Expanding permissions goes through the owner or an admin, and is logged.

principles.title: Transparency for managers
principles.body: The owner sees who changed a stock count, closed a work order, or granted permissions, in the realtime activity log.

principles.title: A production-ready stack
principles.body: Firebase Authentication, Firestore Security Rules, and a server-only API that checks companyId and role on every request.

stack.detail: Firebase Auth: email, Apple ID. Sessions are managed by the platform.
Firestore rules restrict reads and writes by companyId and user role.
Server-side access checks before any operation on orders, stock, or finances.
PDFs and printing use one-time render tokens, with no public links to data.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How AutoCore collects, uses, and protects data for users and companies at auto dismantlers and repair shops.

sections.title: 1. General provisions
paragraphs: This policy describes how personal and operational data is processed in AutoCore, a cloud application for auto dismantlers and repair shops.

By using the AutoCore web app, desktop client, or mobile app, you confirm that you have reviewed this policy. Company admins are responsible for the accuracy of data for the employees they invite into their organization.

sections.title: 2. Who this policy applies to
paragraphs: This policy applies to owners and employees of customer companies, users of demo access, and visitors to the myautocore.com marketing site.
bullets: Employees with role-based access (warehouse, shop floor, accounting, etc.)

sections.title: 3. What data we process
paragraphs: We only process the data necessary to operate the product, support our users, and comply with legal requirements.
bullets: Account data: email, name, sign-in provider ID (Google, Apple, etc.)
Company data: name, business details, branding settings, plan
Operational data: warehouse, work orders, accounting, documents, VINs, and vehicle records
Activity log: who changed what, and when, within the system
Technical data: IP address, device type, client version, error diagnostics

sections.title: 4. Purposes of processing
paragraphs: Data is used exclusively to provide and improve the AutoCore service.
bullets: Sign-up, authentication, and managing employee access
Syncing data across web, desktop, and mobile
Technical support and security incident investigation

sections.title: 5. Storage and protection
paragraphs: Data is stored on secure Google Cloud / Firebase infrastructure. Access is restricted by security rules at the company (tenant) level and by employee roles (RBAC).
Data is transferred between client and server over encrypted channels (TLS). Critical operations are additionally checked on the server, not just in the interface.

sections.title: 6. Sharing with third parties
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. To operate the service we work with vetted processors that act under contract and only to the extent required to deliver the service.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You can request access to your data, its correction, or its deletion by contacting support. A company admin manages employee access and can deactivate accounts within the organization.
When a company is deleted, operational data is removed in accordance with our internal retention and backup procedures.

sections.title: 8. Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The marketing site may use technical cookies for sessions and basic traffic analytics. Within the AutoCore app, cookies are used to maintain your sign-in session.

sections.title: 9. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy as product features or legal requirements change. The current version is always available on this page, with the update date noted.

sections.title: 10. Contact
paragraphs: For questions about data processing, email the support address listed on the "Contact" page. Please put "Privacy" in the subject line.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: The rules for using the AutoCore cloud application for auto dismantlers, repair shops, and related auto businesses.

sections.title: 1. Subject of the agreement
paragraphs: AutoCore provides software as a service (SaaS) for managing a warehouse, work orders, documents, accounting, and a team.
These terms govern the use of the AutoCore web app, desktop clients, and mobile apps.

sections.title: 2. Account
paragraphs: Users must keep their account credentials confidential and must not share access with third parties without the company admin's consent.
The company owner or admin manages employee invitations, roles, and responsibility for actions taken within the organization.

sections.title: 3. Acceptable use
paragraphs: The service is intended for the lawful operation of an auto business.
bullets: You may not disrupt the system, bypass access restrictions, or perform unauthorized testing
You may not upload malicious code or use the service for unlawful purposes
You may not copy, decompile, or reproduce the software without the rights holder's consent

sections.title: 4. Customer data
paragraphs: Operational data entered into AutoCore (warehouse, work orders, finances, documents) remains the customer's property. AutoCore acts as a processor while providing the service.
The customer is responsible for the accuracy of the data they enter and for complying with legal requirements when handling their own customers' personal data.

sections.title: 5. Subscription and billing
paragraphs: Paid features are activated according to the selected plan. Trial, payment, and cancellation terms are described on the "Pricing" page and during subscription checkout in the app.
If payment is missed, access may be restricted, while company data is retained in accordance with the retention policy.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual property
paragraphs: Rights to the AutoCore software, interface, brand, and documentation belong to the rights holder. Customers are granted a non-exclusive license to use the service for the duration of their subscription.

sections.title: 7. Privacy
paragraphs: The processing of personal data is governed by the Privacy Policy. Using the service means you agree to its terms to the extent required.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: The service is provided within reasonable technical limits. AutoCore is not liable for indirect damages, lost profits, or decisions made by the customer based solely on system data without internal verification.
The customer must verify critical financial and warehouse operations according to their own internal procedures.

sections.title: 9. Termination of access
paragraphs: The customer may stop using the service at any time. AutoCore may restrict access for a material breach of these terms or as required by law.

sections.title: 10. Contact
paragraphs: For legal questions and terms of use, reach out through the "Contact" page. Please put "Terms of Use" in the subject line.
